source_clause: PRINFO2.) The Info button will also be visible on the All Profiles tab and show the same page as from the Edit Profiles tab.
leaf_desc_037: PRINFO2.) The Info button will also be visible on the All Profiles tab and show the same page as from the Edit Profiles tab.
reasoning: 驗證目標：10.3（PRINFO2）—— All Profiles 分頁亦有資訊按鈕，且顯示與 Edit Profile 分頁相同之頁面。關鍵情境條件：「相同」須以比對驗之，故步驟 1 先記錄另一入口之頁面。為什麼這樣切：該頁之內容屬 10.3.1；本條之單位是「第二入口與其同一性」，故判 P3 —— 失效時仍可由 Edit Profile 進入。

tcs.tc_title: Info button on the All Profiles tab opens the same page
tcs.test_item: Info button on the All Profiles tab opens the same page
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A Driver Profile is active
2. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the info button on the “Edit Profile” tab
2. Record the page shown
3. Open the “All Profiles” tab
4. Press the info button and check that the page recorded in step 2 is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The linked info page is displayed
2. The page is recorded
3. The “All Profiles” tab is displayed with an info button
4. The same page as recorded in step 2 is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: 同一頁之**第二入口**；失效時仍可由 Edit Profile 進入
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
